lines.text: A comic panel slams in: Muhammad Zohair Shaikh, Game Developer.
The camera pushes in on the cover of this book and its character: “Welcome to my world!”
The toolkit, on the beat: Unity, Unreal Engine 5, gameplay programming, 3D environments.
The Projects page turns, then four panels: Scorched (Unreal Engine 5), Darkness Within (Unity), Last Dance (Unity) and 2D Maze Pathfinding (Unity and C#).
A splash page brings the projects and the cover together, with the address zohair-3-d-portfolio.vercel.app.
